# Tab5 simulator renders

**Simulator output, NOT device framebuffer captures.** Generated by
`tools/sim_tab5.py`, which stubs the M5 API and runs the real
`pulselink_tab5.py` source unmodified up to (not including) its main loop.

Regenerate with:

```bash
./tools/sim_tab5.py
```

## What these are good for

The Tab5 app is now half behind a touchscreen, and it can only be reached over
serial. Nobody working remotely can tap a sub-screen, so the developer, power,
spectrum and sensors screens were unreachable — the only available evidence
that they worked would have been "it compiled". These renders are how those
screens get looked at at all.

The simulator has already caught, in the code it was written to check: a crash
on a zero-width text field, and an FFT axis label that ran off the bottom of
the panel.

## Fidelity — the two halves are not equally trustworthy

- **Measurement is device-accurate.** `textWidth()` / `fontHeight()` reproduce
  the metrics measured on the real panel (DejaVu72 is 52 px tall, `"8888"` is
  124 px wide, and so on), so `fit()` picks exactly the face the device picks
  and every layout decision shown here is the real one. `DejaVu18` and
  `DejaVu12` are interpolated — they were never measured on hardware — and the
  tool prints that caveat on every run.
- **Rendering is an approximation.** Glyphs are drawn with Pillow and
  DejaVuSans at a size chosen to match the metric model. Positions and shapes
  are right; letterforms and antialiasing are not the panel's.

So: trust these for *does it fit, does it overlap, does it throw*. Do not trust
them for *is this the exact pixel the device lights*. The device prints its own
measured geometry at boot and that remains the authority.

## Files

| File | Screen |
|---|---|
| `tab5-main.png` | Dashboard — waveform, BPM/IBI, SIG + coach |
| `tab5-menu.png` | App menu (roadmap 5) |
| `tab5-sensors.png` | Multiple sensors, BPM+IBI per stick (roadmap 4) |
| `tab5-fft.png` | Spectrum analyzer with harmonics (roadmap 6) |
| `tab5-dev.png` | Developer dashboard (roadmap 2) |
| `tab5-power.png` | Power dashboard (roadmap 3) |
| `tab5-rot{0,1,2,3}.png` | The dashboard in all four orientations (roadmap 1) |

The data in every render is **synthesised** by the simulator — a clean
sinusoidal PPG with a dicrotic notch. No physiological measurement is shown.
